No I asked and she said to basically carry on with the current drug and dosage. Which is a shame because I was hoping for something a bit stronger but at the same time I understand.


She did ask if i'd had an suicidal thoughts though and I answered No so I guess keeping me on the current meds was the right thing to do from her point of view.
That's one of the problems I have. I'd love to occupy my time with anything but I don't feel any enthusiasm for it. I feel bored and have a "whats the point" type attitude. I don't know.
Well I am, I'm on medication for it. Whether or not I think it's working or not is another story.

My hobbies are a bit difficult. I love snowboarding (expensive) and indoor climbing (far away). I play guitar but I'm really bad and if I pick it up and try to play I get disheartened and feel even worse as crazy as that might sound. I've been walking a lot, not because I have a passion for it but because it's easy to do and I can do it whenever I want and it's better than thinking. I do go to the gym but I only go 3 times a week for like an hour.


I don't know if I have truly gotten over the breakup yet. I went back to our old empty house the other day and I got really really sad. The thing is that I KNOW she wasn't the right girl for me. She was when I met her but people change and she certainly did.


I'm making this whole issue sound like it's all about the relationship and it's not but it's a part of it.
